purpose: Natural custom text printed directly on existing hat fabric. No label box, patch, background rectangle, or clothing-text replacement.
audit_method: Visual inspection of all 48 original sprites, followed by semi-transparent quadrilateral overlays on all 19 supported hats.

0.notes: Front baseball-cap panel, refined against the supplied reference for taller lettering, a slight left lean and a gently down-right baseline. Clear of the mesh, hair and brim.

2.notes: Left beanie cuff; keep clear of the white cat badge on the right.

3.notes: Upper front bucket-hat crown; keep clear of left ventilation eyelets and lower brim seam.

4.notes: Front baseball-cap panel; stay above the curved brim.

7.notes: Left beanie cuff between the buns; keep clear of the right cat badge.

8.notes: Front-right bucket-hat crown; keep clear of left ventilation eyelets and lower brim.

10.notes: Small left side panel of a backward cap; do not print across the rear opening or adjustable strap. Low text capacity.

12.notes: Broad diagonal beret fabric; avoid the top stem and lower hairline.

13.notes: Newsboy-cap crown above the band; avoid the lower-left button and brim.

17.notes: Small purple left side panel of the winter hat; the front is white fur. Low text capacity.

19.notes: Left side panel of a backward cap; avoid the opening, strap and side brim.

22.notes: Left beanie cuff; avoid the rectangular badge on the right.

25.notes: Newsboy-cap crown; avoid the left button and lower band/brim.

32.notes: Diagonal beret fabric; keep clear of the lower-left brooch and ribbon.

33.notes: Sports-visor front band; avoid the two white diagonal stripes on the left and the white brim edge.

35.notes: Large left panel of the sideways/backward cap; avoid the opening and adjustable strap on the right.

37.notes: Narrow sunhat crown above the white band; avoid the large left bow, band and brim. Low text height.

38.notes: Left knitted beanie cuff; avoid the cat badge and decorative ears.

46.notes: Upper-right painter-beret panel; avoid the white paint motif on the lower-left.

0.reason: Final reference-matched front panel: taller text area and natural cap perspective.

excluded: Hoods 15 and 24, transparent cyber visor 23, headphones, hair ornaments and non-fabric accessories are not editable cap surfaces.

lettering_reference.characteristics: Bold sans lettering with a double-storey a, straight l stem, tight spacing, slight left lean and a baseline descending gently to the right. The supplied clank word is approximately 110×39–40 pixels when normalized to a 512px portrait.
lettering_reference.recommendation: Bundled Geist Variable at weight 750 with horizontal condensation 0.80, autofitted into each hat surface. Preserve cap shading and texture through the ink. Rounded MPlus was too rounded; Archivo Black was heavier and wider than the reference.
